review.assessment: This change introduces a brand-new `solution.ts` with an 8-line implementation that relies entirely on naive string splitting (`&` and `=`). It completely fails to address any of the specified requirements: repeated keys are overwritten instead of collected into arrays, percent-encoding (`%XX`) and plus signs (`+`) are left undecoded, bare keys resolve to `undefined` instead of an empty string, an empty input yields a single falsy entry instead of `{}`, and a leading `?` is treated as part of the first key.

findings.at: Repeated keys overwrite previous values instead of collecting them into an array.
Percent-encoded characters and plus signs are not decoded to spaces or their respective characters.
Bare keys (missing `=`) are assigned `undefined` instead of an empty string.
Empty input results in a single entry with an empty string key instead of returning `{}`.
A leading `?` is not stripped and becomes part of the first key.
